title: Exclude rank 15 in the fixed P120 quadratic space (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Legal P120 patterns in the fixed quadratic column space of #7087 have rank at least 16 over every field of characteristic three. Sixteen uniquely forced columns certify this obstruction. A new rank-31 point belongs to the same space, so its restricted minimum lies in [16,31].

```text
fixed 36-dimensional quadratic space
  legal column equations force 16 independent columns
  therefore rank 15 is impossible in this space
  explicit factors attain rank 31 in the same space
```

Claim type: finite certificate with a scoped algebraic proof. The new result separates this fixed space from unpaidmoon's existing unrestricted rank-15 clique construction in #7014. The rank-31 point does not improve the unrestricted window bound. No new kappa, physical decoder, supplier admission or selected-frontier change is claimed.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Credit unpaidmoon for #7087's space, rank-32 point and open questions, #6953's quadratic construction, #7014's stronger clique pattern and #6946's odd-characteristic bounds; DreamingOfClouds for #6933's port-window framework; Bukh, Cox, Blasiak and Haemers for the fractional Haemers framework. Classical linear algebra retains its credit. The main direct predecessor is #7087 at `043b334e7249e8b79e437a0765773a7e2fc8b8e8`.

## Evidence

Before: #7087 supplies a rank-32 point in the fixed 36-dimensional space without minimizing over its legal fibers. #7014 already supplies unrestricted rank 15. After: the new rank-16 obstruction shows that the fixed space cannot attain that stronger rank, and the new rank-31 factors lower its constructive ceiling by one. Neither restricted endpoint is claimed optimal.

The standalone checker computes 14,400 matrix entries, checks 120 diagonal entries and 6,720 forced zeros, evaluates three rank-31 determinants, checks 3,720 fixed-space membership entries and 912 forced-column equations, and verifies 16 nonzero uniqueness determinants and a nonzero 16-by-16 independence minor. Eleven rejection controls and three small determinant fixtures pass. Generated receipts bind all eight package files. No predecessor scientific suite was replayed.

At head `3cc68fb0585fa78baf121707c8a3154081f4515c`, local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64:

- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks pass with identical receipts, timed at 0.065466 and 0.056652 seconds.
- Both registered commands and metadata validation pass. Each registered command takes under 0.1 seconds locally and has a 60-second timeout.
- Exact committed-byte and source-history checks pass on all eight files.
- Official export integrity and declared-input coverage pass. An optimized exported replay with read-only files, empty PATH and no Git access passes.
- Syntax compilation and whitespace checks pass. The worktree is clean.

From the repository root:

```sh

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error -X dev -O research/p120-char3-rank31-window/verify.py

```

Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the local path. Expected scientific marker: `PASS_P120_CHAR3_RANK31 no_new_kappa`. There are no third-party requirements or live external inputs. The finite checker needs no Git or network access; the publication preflight needs full Git history. Catalogue and selected-record provenance are pinned at canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`.

## Limits and scope correction

The initial [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19542430) sought an unrestricted rank-31 improvement. The broader live-PR check exposed #7014's stronger prior construction. A public [scope correction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19542514) preceded publication. This PR delivers the fixed-space obstruction and the new point inside that space, rather than a global upper-bound improvement.

The theorem is uniform over characteristic-three fields. Exhaustive computations concern only the displayed finite certificate. No characterization of every rigid column, exact restricted optimum, characteristic-zero realization, physical/native decoder, complete paid invoice, caller, stock, precision or movement guarantee is supplied. The five selected assumptions remain unchanged. The selected scientific replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Determine the exact minimum rank in this fixed space. Start with a hyperplane meeting every legal affine fiber in the delivered rank-31 span; a failed search would not settle the minimum.
- Identify an enlargement or change of feature space admitting a rank-15 point. Start by expressing the cited clique columns in a larger space. No physical cost follows from such membership alone.
- Find a separate characteristic-zero factorization and complete decoder invoice if this finite-field geometry is to help the complex supplier.

## Related open work

- #7087 is the direct quadratic-space predecessor. Its reported rank-32 point is cited, not reverified; this adds a rank-16 restriction and a different rank-31 point in that same space.
- #7014 already supplies the stronger unrestricted rank-15 clique construction over every field. This PR proves that no rank-15 point has all its columns in the fixed space considered here; it does not audit that clique construction.
- #7114 studies all block patterns and the characteristic-two window, with related general field statements. This PR fixes a particular characteristic-three column space; it makes no competing unrestricted window claim.
- #2832 studies real/complex E8 decoder COPY floors and reductions. The present finite-characteristic matrix rank gives no COPY comparison.
- #3074 transfers one-sided P112 decoders to P120 at an explicit COPY cost. This PR supplies no one-sided decoder or COPY tariff.
- #5064 records bounded masked-E8 completion and basis searches with physical COPY objectives. The fixed characteristic-three feature-space rank here is a different objective.
- #7127 counts P120 ports in binary subspaces. This contribution computes no competing ports-per-dimension number.
- #7174 excludes one 96-line E8 complement at inner dimension 8k. This PR concerns the full P120 mask in a fixed quadratic space and computes no competing complement value.
- #7170 bounds complex scalar COPY savings at a 93-line puncture. This PR provides no puncture or scalar COPY comparison.
- #7168 gives Gram-class COPY minima through 24 deleted E8 lines. This PR computes neither a Gram-class nor a deleted-line minimum.
- #7129 proves block-fitting floors for star-configuration graphs. This PR concerns a fixed column space on the full P120 mask and computes no competing star-graph value.

Completion refresh inspected the nine other open PRs from this account created since the CLAIM: #7261, #7262, #7263, #7264, #7265, #7267, #7268, #7269 and #7270. None studies this P120 fixed quadratic column space or computes its restricted rank. No additional same-object comparison or scientific computation was run.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `3cc68fb0585fa78baf121707c8a3154081f4515c`, [run 43029993808](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029993808), [plan job 130554266928](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029993808/job/130554266928), failed in Onboarding helper tests. I read the completed checks once and inspected the job log. Exactly one of 760 tests failed, with 24 skipped:

```text
test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record
AssertionError: '`make frontier7000-verify`' not found in the CI verification document
```

At canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still opens with Current selected-family replay: #6030 and documents `make frontier6030-verify`. Both files and the failing test are unchanged by this PR. The package [replay job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029993808/job/130556647191) was skipped because plan failed. The evidence for this package remains the local checks listed above.

I also inspected the actual logs of [42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), [43029125610](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029125610), [43029249083](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029249083) and [43029427643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43029427643). Each has the same sole failing test, the same missing-command AssertionError, 760 tests and 24 skips. No fix, retrigger commit, push or job rerun was made. The repository documentation repair remains with maintainers.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: package. Eight additive files in one opt-in research directory. Shared code, frozen predecessor packages and the selected frontier are unchanged.
